name: Media Review
summary:
**Media Review** is a collaborative VR video review tool for the Meta Quest. Watch footage together in real-time with frame-accurate synced playback across user headsets.

## **FRAME .IO INTEGRATION**
Browse your Frame projects, download assets directly to your headset, and create shared review rooms. Post timestamped comments and draw annotations on-screen — all synced back to Frame.io.
